name: comp-318
title: Sticky Footer Dialog
blurb: Example FAQ dialog with sticky footer while content scrolls above.
description: A premade dialog template showing how to keep action buttons fixed at the bottom while content scrolls independently.
use_when: Building dialogs where buttons should remain visible while scrolling through long content.
avoid_when: When footer scrolling is acceptable — this requires custom layout.
a11y: Uses Dialog primitives with semantic footer and action buttons.
